svg.aria-label: One edge of a blade along t, from the root at 0 to the tip at 1. The high level has eight vertex pairs, 0 to 7, whose steps shrink toward the tip; the low level has four, at the high level's pairs 0, 2, 4 and 7, the pairs both levels share.
